messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 — Elevated Xid 31/43 and ECC correctable counts observed across us-east-1 inference pool. Auto-created incident INC-5043210000. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/alerts/5043210000

rachel: oncall rachel here. Seeing kernel oops and container restarts in canary group (inference-canary-3). Which nodes are root-cause candidates?

josh: noisy nodes: canary-3, canary-7, prod-45. NVML shows repeated 'Xid 31: PID 0' and ECC corrected counts spiking on canary-7.

neha: impact: upstream request queue depth rising for routes backed by prod-45. Some clients hit `504` at LB level for ~30s windows. No full outage.

dave: started mitigation: flipping traffic away from affected shards via routing rule `route.override=warm-spare` for model redwood-8b-highmem. Command: `redwoodctl route set-reroute --route redwood-8b-highmem --target warm-spare --reason xid-spike`

rachel: running `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,MEMORY` on canary-7, attaching snippet: ```Fan Speed: 30 %
ECC Errors (Correctable): 324
ECC Errors (Uncorrectable): 0```

josh: interesting — corrected ECCs high but no UCEs. However kernel shows `NVRM: RmInitAdapter failed` intermittently and `GPU lockup` entries.

neha: routing change reduced tail latency for critical customers by ~70%, see /dash/latency. SLOs temporarily stable.

sre-bot: telemetry: serving-runtime pod restarts increase from 0.05/min -> 0.9/min across affected nodes in last 12m.

dave: attempting soft mitigation: disable KV cache on affected pods (env REDWOOD_KVCACHE_SIZE=0) and restart deployment to drop memory pressure. Doing canary first: `kubectl set env deploy/serving-canary REDWOOD_KVCACHE_SIZE=0`

rachel: that reduced memory usage on canary-3 by ~1.2GB, but canary-7 still shows NV driver resets.

nate: rolled driver back to package 520.56->515.76 on canary-7 using `ansible -i hosts -l canary-7 playbooks/driver-rollback.yml`. Driver came back, but Xid entries still appear occasionally.

josh: we have a kernel oops stack: ```[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (0003:00000031) 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000000
[ 12345.679012] kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000040```

neha: customer comms drafted: "We detected GPU driver resets impacting inference latency for a subset of requests. Traffic was migrated and mitigations deployed; engineers are investigating and we'll update in 30 minutes."

dave: ops action: cordon prod-45 and move noncritical pods. `kubectl cordon prod-45 && kubectl drain prod-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

hw-ops: requested ECC dump and SMART for disks. Also asking for GPU warranty check for canary-7 (serial GPU-SN-4422) if UCEs increase. Opening HW ticket TICKET-7429.

rachel: decision checkpoint: continue driver rollback to confirmed nodes if rollback demonstrates stability for 15m without Xid spikes. Also run `memtest` on suspect nodes during maintenance window.

sre-bot: metric update: error-rate for /v1/chat/completions for shard A dropped to 0.7% after reroute. Overall platform error-rate at 0.9% (still elevated vs baseline 0.1%).

josh: collected `serving-runtime` core at /var/crash/serving-runtime.core. Uploading to analysis bucket: s3://redwood-analysis/incidents/5043210000/serving-runtime.core

neha: handoff: @dave will be primary for next 1 hour, @rachel will shadow then take over monitoring. Leaving bridge open.

dave: note for handoff: commands run, driver rollback on canary-7, KV cache disabled on canary-3, prod-45 cordoned. Logs stored under /incidents/5043210000/logs.tar.gz.

hw-ops: reporting back: no UCEs yet, ECC counts look like thermal-induced correctable bursts. Recommend running GPU temperature sweep and confirm airflow.

rachel: action items post-incident: 1) add automation to failover routes faster if Xid rate > 10/min 2) add automated driver rollback playbook trigger after N consecutive Xid31s 3) review KV cache memory limits to avoid kernel OOMs.

sre-bot: incident state changed: monitoring -> mitigated. Bridge remains open for verification. Timeline saved to /incidents/5043210000/timeline.log

dave: closing notes: no customers lost data; transient latency observed for a subset. Will follow up with RCA and proposed infra changes. Handing to @rachel for post-mortem doc. :white_check_mark:

rachel: ack — will open postmortem and link RCA here. Thanks team.
